carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting sharp light-to-shadow gradients with high-intensity highlights on the superior edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin displays a sparse distribution of approximately 6-8 high-luminance spots localized primarily within the lower two-thirds of the fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of Echeneidae (remoras) is attached to the posterior edge of the visible pectoral fin; a large school of small teleost fish is present beneath the ventral-lateral flank.
